Scope.description: tenant_id always comes from the authenticated principal, never the body.
Scope.title: Scope

SkillImport.description: Import an existing SKILL.md (Anthropic / Hermes / agentskills.io format).
SkillImport.title: SkillImport

Verification.description: Ground-truth signal from tests, validators or business checks. The strongest learning signal there is.
Verification.title: Verification

info.description: Plug-in self-improvement for any agent framework: skills, memory, reflection, evolution, canary rollout and governance.
info.title: Myelinate

post.description: Create a tenant API key with the given scopes. The key is only shown once.

schema.title: Response Create Key V1 Admin Api Keys Post

get.description: List the tenant's audit log, newest first.

schema.title: Response Audit Log V1 Admin Audit Get

get.description: Learning-side LLM usage per day and purpose (for budgets and chargeback).

schema.title: Response Usage V1 Admin Usage Get

delete.description: Right to erasure: memories, profile and episodes of a user in this tenant.

schema.title: Response Erase User V1 Admin Users  User Id  Delete

post.description: Queue library upkeep for an agent now (dedup, lifecycle, nomination, profiles).

schema.title: Response Trigger Curation V1 Agents  Agent Id  Curate Post

get.description: Export episodes with rewards as JSON Lines (for analytics, RL or fine-tuning).
Learning lift vs the holdout group, per-skill success rates, canaries, problem rules and learning cost.

schema.title: Response Insights V1 Agents  Agent Id  Insights Get

post.description: Queue reflection over an agent's unreflected episodes now.

schema.title: Response Trigger Reflection V1 Agents  Agent Id  Reflect Post

post.description: Re-learn from stored episodes (another epoch), e.g. after importing history or changing the model.

schema.title: Response Replay V1 Agents  Agent Id  Replay Post

post.description: Answer a question from learned evidence only (skills, memories, profile), with cited evidence ids.

get.description: List changesets (proposed skill changes), by default those pending review.

schema.title: Response List Changesets V1 Changesets Get

get.description: A changeset as a reviewable suggestion: current and proposed SKILL.md, a unified diff, and the evidence.

schema.title: Response Proposal V1 Changesets  Cs Id  Proposal Get

post.description: Approve or reject a pending changeset. Risky changes to proven skills start a canary unless skipped.

schema.title: Response Review V1 Changesets  Cs Id  Review Post

post.description: Record a finished run (messages, tool calls, outcome, verification) so the agent can learn from it.

get.description: Most recent episode of a session, so stateless clients can attach feedback to 'the last turn'.

schema.title: Response Latest Episode V1 Episodes Latest Get

post.description: Bulk import of historical runs (offline warm-up: ACE showed warm-starting lifts online learning).

schema.title: Response Record Batch V1 Episodes Batch Post

post.description: Rate a recorded episode (0-1), optionally with a comment or the correct answer.

get.description: List memories, optionally for a user, at a point in time (`as_of`) or with superseded history.

schema.title: Response List Memories V1 Memories Get

post.description: Add a memory. It is reconciled against existing memories (add, update, supersede or no-op).

schema.title: Response Add Memory V1 Memories Post

delete.description: Hard delete (e.g. data-subject request). Learning itself never hard-deletes; it supersedes.

post.description: Approve a memory held for review (e.g. flagged by the safety scan).

schema.title: Response Approve Memory V1 Memories  Memory Id  Approve Post

get.description: Get the profile card for a user of an agent.

schema.title: Response Get Profile V1 Profiles  Agent Id   User Id  Get

post.description: Retrieve learned skills, memories and the user's profile for a task, as ready-to-inject instructions.

get.description: List an agent's skills (plus tenant-shared ones) with their rules and success rates.

schema.title: Response List Skills V1 Skills Get

post.description: Create or replace a skill by hand (applied through a governed changeset).

schema.title: Response Author Skill V1 Skills Post

post.description: Bring existing SKILL.md files (Anthropic / Hermes / agentskills.io) under learning and governance.

schema.title: Response Import Skill V1 Skills Import Post

get.description: Get one skill by id or name.
Export a skill as an agentskills.io-compatible SKILL.md.
List a skill's immutable version history.

schema.title: Response Skill Versions V1 Skills  Ref  Versions Get

post.description: Queue an evolution run for a skill.

schema.title: Response Trigger Evolution V1 Skills  Skill Id  Evolve Post

post.description: Pin or unpin a skill. Pinned skills are never archived by the lifecycle.

schema.title: Response Pin V1 Skills  Skill Id  Pin Post

post.description: Restore a skill to an earlier version (recorded as a new version).

schema.title: Response Rollback V1 Skills  Skill Id  Rollback Post

post.description: Zero-code ingestion of OpenTelemetry GenAI / OpenInference traces.

schema.title: Response Otlp Traces V1 Traces Post
